description: Test suite for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor component, containing numerous unit tests that validate markdown preprocessing functionalities, such as image extraction, metadata stripping, prefix removal, and handling of untrusted content.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessorTests
classes.description: A test suite struct that contains multiple unit tests for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.

methods.name: extractsDataURLImages
methods.description: Tests extracting base64-encoded data image URLs from markdown.

methods.name: flattensRemoteMarkdownImagesIntoText
methods.description: Tests handling of remote image URLs and their conversion to text.

methods.name: usesFallbackTextForUnlabeledRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Tests fallback label when image URL lacks alt text.

methods.name: handlesUnicodeBeforeRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Ensures unicode characters preceding images are preserved properly.

methods.name: stripsInboundUntrustedContextBlocks
methods.description: Tests removal of inbound untrusted metadata blocks enclosed in json fences.

methods.name: stripsSingleConversationInfoBlock
methods.description: Tests removal of a single conversation info json block.

methods.name: stripsAllKnownInboundMetadataSentinels
methods.description: Iterates over known untrusted metadata headers and verifies their removal.

methods.name: preservesNonMetadataJsonFence
methods.description: Ensures JSON fences not related to untrusted metadata are preserved.

methods.name: stripsLeadingTimestampPrefix
methods.description: Removes leading timestamp prefixes from messages.

methods.name: stripsEnvelopeHeadersAndMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes envelope headers and message ID hints from markdown.

methods.name: stripsTrailingUntrustedContextSuffix
methods.description: Removes untrusted context suffixes for cleaner message content.

methods.name: preservesUntrustedContextHeaderWhenItIsUserContent
methods.description: Verifies that untrusted context headers are preserved if they contain user content.
